notes: Skills get a two-stage protocol and a proactive brain. The new search_skills tool browses skill metadata (name, description, usage, tags) by keyword or tags — cheap, read-only, cached — before the agent commits tokens to a load_skill. On top of that, a skill auto-router inspects the workspace (package.json deps, files, folders, language fingerprint, PRD.md) plus the task’s wording, and pre-loads the matching skills into context (max 3, score-gated, ~8k chars each) with full transparency: a 🎯 notice in the TUI, the match reasons in the system prompt, and an [auto-router] line in WORKLOG.md. /skills, /reload-skills, /no-auto-skill and /unload-skill keep you in charge.
